On a hardworking day we read your thoughts, and a new handler looked into it We understand that your complaint concerns the way your pet was received and cared for during travel, and we are sorry that the experience left you feeling uneasy. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk treats every journey as a shared responsibility, and we regret that our service did not reflect that standard in your case.

A welfare coordinator reviewed the comfort notes linked to the trip, and a safety coordinator checked the handling steps for any gaps that may have affected the experience. We have also asked the team to revisit the handoff process so that each animal receives patient attention from trained staff from the moment of check-in through arrival. When concerns are raised, we take them seriously, because comfort, safety, and calm treatment should remain constant at every stage.

If any part of the journey felt rushed, unclear, or poorly managed, that should not have happened. We are using your comments to reinforce reminders about gentle communication, careful observation, and close coordination between the people who prepare the animal and the people who receive it. Your note helps us improve how we support both travelers and the animals in our care.

Please be assured that we value the trust placed in Aurelia Skyways, and we want future trips to feel more settled and dependable. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue to review its routines with attention to welfare and prevention, so the service remains more consistent for every traveler and every animal.
